summary: Growth and belief support freedom and disruption. This cooperative pattern asks you to use optimism and originality with awareness.
body: Growth and belief support freedom and disruption. This cooperative pattern asks you to use optimism and originality with awareness. Seen as forward-thinking and ahead of the curve; you get away with it. The connection is available when you choose to use it; it works best through deliberate practice. In practice, this can show up through growth and belief, freedom and disruption, and the choices you make when overreach or instability starts running the room.
gift: The gift is optimism, originality, and a more conscious way to work with growth and belief and freedom and disruption.
shadow: The shadow is overreach, instability, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let growth and belief and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovative thinking whose reception depends heavily on how it's framed.
do: Name how growth and belief and freedom and disruption are both involved
Turn optimism and originality into one concrete choice
dont: Ignore the needs of growth and belief or freedom and disruption
